disposition.reason: The required version-3 health gate succeeded, but the first pair/field-first nonblank advanced diagnostic terminated without a reconcilable result. Same-field pair semantics and every remaining advanced, detail, control, strict, and planned-cell requirement remain unresolved; the pilot stopped without retry.
human_verification_required: Review E-002's terminal advanced-form navigation timeout and owned-page cleanup discrepancy without treating it as a source zero or a successful field-semantic test.
Decide whether any later separately authorized pilot may use a cleanup-safe advanced diagnostic; do not directly reissue E-002.
Require a demonstrated compliant same-field pair method before allowing BG1, BG2, BC1, or BT2 for final use.
Do not accept P03, update central status, or run a final OATD search from these drafts.
